notes: Partition verified: 29 source / 32 target, each used once across 28 units.
*never* rests on לֹא alone and עוֹד keeps *any more*; this is not rule 35's לֹא ... לְעוֹלָם fusion, since the temporal word has a rendering of its own.

The existential יִהְיֶה is unrepresented once the ASV recasts the clause as *open thy mouth*, with פִּתְחוֹן carrying *open*; the possessive לְ goes unrepresented and its suffix takes *thy* (rules 40, 43).
The chapter-wide אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה convention (supplied *the* on the construct, 1cs suffix unrepresented) is applied here as elsewhere in the chapter.
